name: Court-order deadline notice preparation
summary: When a court order arrives, the legal assistant has a draft notice ready for the attorney: every directive in the court’s own words, every date copied from the order or proposed under the firm’s own written rule file, and a list for the attorney to confirm. Nothing is calendared or sent until the attorney confirms.

sources.title: Its own built worked example of a court-order notice, made for an invented firm and an invented court.
